domains.name: ServiceNow Fundamentals
domains.description: ServiceNow fundamentals: platform architecture/data model, navigation/system settings, and instance security.

domains.name: IT Service Management (ITSM) Implementation
domains.description: IT Service Management (ITSM) implementation: core process modules, form/table customization, integrations, SLAs/catalogs, and workflow automation.

domains.name: Customer Service Management (CSM) Implementation
domains.description: Customer Service Management (CSM) implementation: case management, portals, Virtual Agent, routing automation, and CRM integration.

domains.name: HR Service Delivery (HRSD) Implementation
domains.description: HR Service Delivery (HRSD) implementation: HR case/knowledge, self-service portals, lifecycle automation, compliance, and HRIS/payroll integration.

domains.name: Configuration Management Database (CMDB) and Asset Management
domains.description: CMDB and asset management: CI/relationship modeling, discovery/reconciliation, dependency mapping, asset lifecycle, and governance.

domains.name: Service Portal and UI Customization
domains.description: Service Portal and UI customization: portal design, widgets (HTML/CSS/AngularJS), responsive/navigation, Knowledge Base, and performance/accessibility.

domains.name: Automation and Scripting
domains.description: Automation and scripting: business rules/client scripts/UI policies, Flow Designer/Scripted REST, scheduled jobs/events, and ServiceNow APIs.

domains.name: Integrations and Data Management
domains.description: Integrations and data management: Integration Hub, imports/transform maps, REST/SOAP middleware, data integrity, and integration monitoring.

domains.name: Performance Analytics and Reporting
domains.description: Performance analytics and reporting: reports/dashboards/indicators, operational/executive reporting, KPIs, automation, and report performance/access.

domains.name: Deployment and Governance
domains.description: Deployment and governance: roadmaps/plans, DevOps/release management, Agile/ITIL, test/UAT/prod cycles, and enterprise governance/compliance.

competencies.statement: The learner can work with ServiceNow architecture, data models, and core components.
competencies.description: Explains platform structure and core tables/relationships.

competencies.statement: The learner can navigate the ServiceNow platform to configure and manage system settings.
competencies.description: Finds and adjusts the right settings in the platform.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement instance security controls and user authentication methods.
competencies.description: Configures ACLs/roles and an authentication method.

competencies.statement: The learner can configure ITSM modules including Incident, Problem, Change, and Request Management.
competencies.description: Sets up the correct ITSM process for a scenario.

competencies.statement: The learner can customize forms, fields, and tables to align with ITSM best practices.
competencies.description: Adds/adjusts form and table elements correctly.

competencies.statement: The learner can integrate ITSM with third-party applications and external data sources.
competencies.description: Connects ITSM to an external system.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Service Catalogs.
competencies.description: Configures an SLA/catalog item to a requirement.

competencies.statement: The learner can develop automated workflows using Flow Designer and Business Rules.
competencies.description: Builds a flow/business rule to automate a process.

competencies.statement: The learner can configure CSM for case management and customer-interaction tracking.
The learner can customize ServiceNow CSM portals for an enhanced user experience.
competencies.description: Tailors a CSM portal to user needs.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement Virtual Agent and AI-driven chatbots for customer-service automation.
The learner can develop workflow automations for case routing and resolution.
The learner can integrate CSM with CRM and support tools.
competencies.description: Connects CSM to a CRM/support system.

competencies.statement: The learner can implement HR case and knowledge-management workflows.
competencies.description: Configures HR case and knowledge flows.

competencies.statement: The learner can configure the Employee Service Center and HR portals for self-service access.
The learner can design and automate HR onboarding, offboarding, and lifecycle events.
The learner can ensure compliance with data-privacy and security regulations in HR applications.
competencies.description: Applies privacy/security controls to HR data.

competencies.statement: The learner can integrate HRSD with enterprise HRIS and payroll systems.
The learner can configure and maintain the CMDB to track IT assets, services, and dependencies.
The learner can implement automated discovery and reconciliation for data integrity.
The learner can develop dependency maps for business services and infrastructure components.
competencies.description: Builds an accurate service dependency map.

competencies.statement: The learner can automate IT asset-lifecycle management workflows.
The learner can ensure compliance with CMDB best practices and governance frameworks.
The learner can design and customize ServiceNow Service Portals to improve user experience.
competencies.description: Configures a Service Portal to a need.

competencies.statement: The learner can develop UI pages and widgets using HTML, CSS, and AngularJS.
The learner can implement responsive layouts and user-friendly navigation.
The learner can configure the Knowledge Base for self-service support and documentation.
The learner can optimize portal performance and accessibility for diverse user needs.
The learner can develop and deploy Business Rules, Client Scripts, and UI Policies to automate processes.
The learner can implement the Workflow Editor, Flow Designer, and Scripted REST APIs for automation.
competencies.description: Builds an automation with the right tool.

competencies.statement: The learner can configure Scheduled Jobs and Event Management automation within ServiceNow.
The learner can use ServiceNow APIs for system integrations and custom development.
The learner can implement ServiceNow Integration Hub to connect external APIs and services.
The learner can configure data imports, transform maps, and data-migration workflows.
competencies.description: Maps and imports external data correctly.

competencies.statement: The learner can develop middleware integrations using REST and SOAP web services.
The learner can ensure data integrity through validation, transformation, and error handling.
competencies.description: Adds validation/error handling to an integration.

competencies.statement: The learner can monitor integration performance and optimize synchronization.
The learner can configure reports, dashboards, and Performance Analytics indicators for data visualization.
competencies.description: Builds the right report/indicator for a question.

competencies.statement: The learner can develop real-time operational and executive reports within ServiceNow.
The learner can implement KPIs to measure IT and business metrics.
The learner can automate data collection, aggregation, and visualization.
competencies.description: Automates a data-collection job for reporting.

competencies.statement: The learner can optimize report performance and enforce access-control policies.
competencies.description: Tunes a report and secures its data.

competencies.statement: The learner can develop ServiceNow deployment roadmaps and project implementation plans.
The learner can implement DevOps best practices for ServiceNow development and release management.
The learner can apply Agile and ITIL methodologies in ServiceNow project execution.
The learner can manage testing, UAT, and production deployment cycles for ServiceNow solutions.
competencies.description: Runs a change through test/UAT/prod correctly.

competencies.statement: The learner can ensure compliance with enterprise governance policies and security standards.
